ValidationRule.description: Cheque payments require an uploaded cheque copy; Bank Transfer payments require an uploaded Bank LPO. Both are captured as the Proof of Payment / Receipt Reference.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(AF_PaymentMethod__c, "Cheque"), ISPICKVAL(AF_PaymentMethod__c, "Bank Transfer") ), ISBLANK(AF_ProofReference__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Proof of payment is required for this payment method: attach the cheque copy (Cheque) or Bank LPO (Bank Transfer) and record the reference before saving.
